standard_prerequisites.name: The derived pushforward Rj_* along a quasi-compact open immersion preserves quasi-coherence of cohomology sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the right-inverse mechanism work within D_QCoh.

standard_prerequisites.name: Rj_* is right adjoint to restriction, so restriction composed with Rj_* is the identity on D(O_U)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the lifting of objects from U to X.

standard_prerequisites.name: Rj_* preserves bounded-below complexes and, when X is quasi-compact, bounded-above complexes

core_obligations: First case: the preamble argument (Rj_* is a right inverse to restriction) applies inside D_QCoh because Rj_* maps D_QCoh(O_U) into D_QCoh(O_X) by the quasi-coherence direct-image lemma; hence D_QCoh(O_X) -> D_QCoh(O_U) is essentially surjective (proof lines 3272-3275).
Bounded below: Rj_* clearly maps D^+_QCoh(O_U) into D^+_QCoh(O_X), so the bounded-below restriction is essentially surjective (proof lines 3276-3279).

Bounded above and bounded: by the quasi-coherence direct-image lemma Rj_* maps D^-_QCoh(O_U) into D^-_QCoh(O_X) when X is quasi-compact; combining with the bounded-below case gives essential surjectivity for D^b_QCoh (proof lines 3280-3284).
proof_roadmap: Lift objects by the Rj_* right-inverse mechanism, kept inside D_QCoh by quasi-coherence of Rj_* (proof lines 3272-3275).
Handle the bounded-above case via quasi-compactness and combine for the bounded case (proof lines 3280-3284).
